title: High-Correlation Non-Rotational MORUS Linear Trail
summary: The paper reports rotationally invariant trails for MORUS, while finding a good trail outside that class remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Find a high-absolute-correlation linear trail for $\mathsf{MORUS}$ that is not invariant under word-wise rotations.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptanalysis of MORUS through linear trails and word-wise rotations.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Find a high-absolute-correlation MORUS linear trail that is not rotationally invariant.

citations.label: Correlation of Quadratic Boolean Functions: Cryptanalysis of All Versions of Full $$\mathsf {MORUS}$$

progress.summary: The paper presents this as its second open question after discussing high-absolute-correlation MORUS trails. The supplied evidence reports rotationally invariant trails but no trail satisfying the requested non-invariance.
citation_labels: Danping Shi et al., Correlation of Quadratic Boolean Functions: Cryptanalysis of All Versions of Full $$\mathsf {MORUS}$$
